'''Kylbar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], who served as an aide to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Kylbar served as aide to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], aboard the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] agents transported the child [[Caeleb]] to ''Home One'' and were debriefed by Kylbar, on the behalf of Ackbar. Kylbar then took custody of the child and told the agents that [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], the leader of the Alliance, had arranged for Caeleb to be transported to a safe place.<ref name="COL" />

Four months later, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]] traveled to the place where Kylbar and Caeleb were staying. Rystra used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to make Kylbar think that he was [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], then kidnapped the child. Caeleb was eventually rescued and returned to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel fleet]], where Kylbar again received custody of the boy.<ref name="Soulsaber">"[[Soulsaber (adventure)|Soulsaber]]"</ref>
